title: pavonia candida
intro: Pavonia candida, commonly known as the Rose Mallow or White Pavonia, is a perennial plant species belonging to the family Malvaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations, reduce pain, and protect against cell damage. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
